coherence_notes: Compartments represented across the dataset: Epithelial (Tumor, Myoepithelial); Stromal (Stromal); Immune (Macrophages, T_Cells, B_Cells, Dendritic, Mast_Cells); Endothelial (Endothelial).

Cluster sizes: the largest is c1 Tumor at 62,755 cells, the smallest c9 Mast_Cells at 167 cells. Whether that spread is expected is a question for the tissue, and this review has no grounded basis to answer it.

No redundancy: all 9 called clusters carry distinct cell types (Tumor, Stromal, Macrophages, Myoepithelial, T_Cells, B_Cells, Endothelial, Dendritic, Mast_Cells); no two clusters collapse onto the same call.

refinements.rationale: these markers are plasmacytoid-DC-specific; the subtype is only clear across the whole immune compartment
